# Ministry of Tourism

> A travel workspace for travelers, hosts, tour guides and their AI agents. The board keeps places, source material, selected artwork and trip memories together in the person's browser.

Read the actual board ID, revision and command schemas before proposing changes. Private content is excluded from agent reads and shared exports. Muse availability is explicit; manual editing and export work without a live provider.

- [Trip agent contract: window.motTrip, commands, privacy and portable artifacts](/trip-agents.md)
